canonical_statement: The report describes a rapidly progressive MRSA necrotizing fasciitis case in a previously undiagnosed patient with AIDS and characterizes the infecting MRSA strain molecularly.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We report an unusually severe case of MRSA necrotizing fasciitis in a previously undiagnosed AIDS patient.

canonical_statement: The index patient was a 36-year-old man with no previously recognized significant medical conditions who presented with severe right arm pain, lethargy, fever, and shortness of breath.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A 36-year-old Hispanic male with no previously recognized significant medical conditions presented

canonical_statement: Two weeks before the acute presentation, the patient had been treated with clindamycin for right axillary hidradenitis after a self-reported spider bite, but the skin infection did not resolve.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: He had been treated 2 weeks previously with clindamycin for right axillary hidradenitis

canonical_statement: At emergency presentation, the patient had septic shock with blood pressure 58/32 mm Hg, pulse 130/min, temperature 99.4°F, and white blood cell count 1,600/µL.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: septic shock (blood pressure, 58/32; pulse, 130; temperature, 99.4°F; white blood cell count, 1,600/μl)

canonical_statement: Empiric antimicrobial therapy was started immediately with vancomycin, piperacillin-tazobactam, and clindamycin.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Empirical antimicrobial treatment was initiated immediately with vancomycin, piperacillin-tazobactam, and clindamycin.

canonical_statement: Despite empiric treatment, the patient deteriorated rapidly and required mechanical ventilation, fluids, and vasopressor support.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: his condition deteriorated quickly, and he required ventilator assistance with fluid and vasopressor support.

canonical_statement: Emergency surgical exploration occurred within 24 hours of admission; extensive soft-tissue necrosis was found, the right arm was amputated, and the chest wall was extensively debrided.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Emergency surgical exploration was undertaken within 24 h of admission, and extensive soft tissue necrosis was observed intraoperatively.

canonical_statement: Pre-antibiotic sputum and blood cultures and intraoperative wound cultures grew MRSA resistant to erythromycin, clindamycin, and levofloxacin.

canonical_statement: The authors emphasize that apparently benign MRSA skin and soft-tissue infections can progress rapidly to potentially fatal illness.

canonical_statement: The report notes that epidemiologic data and experimental infection models had not unambiguously established a direct role for PVL or ACME-related mechanisms in invasive disease.
